name: Companion Memory
short_desc: Personal database, RAG, and behavioral prediction — on your own hardware.
author: Companion Intelligence
description: Companion Memory is a fully self-hosted personal database and memory engine for Companion Intelligence: a NestJS REST/LLM API, retrieval-augmented search (RAG) over your own data, automatic summarization, and the HBPE behavioral-prediction engine — all running locally with Ollama and PostgreSQL. No cloud, no data brokers.
